stem.text: Compound X is a single, pure, optical isomer. X is heated with an excess of concentrated $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$. Only one organic product is formed.

A.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with an OH group on one carbon and methyl groups on two adjacent carbons further round the ring.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with an OH group on one carbon and methyl groups on the next two adjacent carbons.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with an OH group and a methyl group on the same carbon, and a methyl group on the adjacent carbon.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with a CH2OH group on one carbon and a methyl group on the adjacent carbon.
